name: Task_1
description: Prepare liquid silicon at 2500 K for a later diffusion calculation. Retrieve the mp-149 conventional cell through Materials Project and repeat it 3 x 3 x 3 to make 216 atoms. Use LAMMPS with metal units, full atom style, and the supplied Stillinger-Weber potential. Initialize the velocities at 300 K with a recorded random seed. Heat the same system continuously from 300 K to 2500 K at 2.2 K/ps under isotropic NPT at zero target pressure. Choose suitable simulation and sampling settings. Do not replace the structure, change the cell by hand, or reinitialize the velocities during heating. Save the prepared 300 K state before heating and the final state at 2500 K, the input and log files, and a time-resolved record of target temperature, measured temperature, pressure, and density. Briefly assess whether the final state is suitable for the later liquid-diffusion run.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in the required fields for this task. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
